title: Business Head – Stock Broking & Financial Services - JG
description:
**Industry: Stock Broking / Financial Services**
**Job Locations:**
Meerut, Kanpur & Mathura
  
  
**Experience:**
3–7 Years
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Work Mode:**
Work from Office
  
  
**Working Hours:**
9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
  
  
**About The Company**
A growing financial services organization offering a range of investment, stock broking, wealth management and financial products.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Business Head with experience in the stock broking or financial services industry to drive business growth, manage teams, develop client relationships and achieve revenue targets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement business strategies to drive revenue and market growth.
* Lead, manage and motivate teams to achieve business targets.
* Drive new client acquisition and strengthen existing client relationships.
* Take ownership of business revenue, profitability and P&L performance.
* Identify opportunities for cross-selling financial products such as mutual funds, insurance and wealth management solutions.
* Build strong relationships with key clients and improve customer retention.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities and business opportunities.
* Oversee daily business operations while ensuring regulatory compliance.
* Focus on client activation, revenue generation and business expansion.
* Explore technology-driven initiatives to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3–7 years of experience in the stock broking or financial services industry.
* Good understanding of stock markets, trading practices and investment products.
* Experience in business development, client acquisition and relationship management.
* Strong team management and leadership skills.
* Understanding of revenue generation, business growth and P&L management.
* Good communication and negotiation skills.
* Proficiency in Hindi and English.
